name: sort-words
description:
The words of the phrase sorted by their character codes, joined by one space.

The order is digits, then latin capitals, latin small letters, cyrillic capitals, cyrillic small letters; «Ё» goes before «А» and «ё» after «я».

Example: semkit read --text "москва купить диван" sort-words write -
-> диван купить москва

The step rewrites the working column; with --as NAME it writes the result to a new column NAME.

options.name: --as
options.description: Write the result to a new column NAME and keep the working column as it is.
